editorialRevision.direction: Near-black and graphite base, silver-white typography, restrained MMCrypto cyan on primary actions, active chapter indicators, focus states, hover details and fine edges. Hero uses a localized softly masked glow, an ice-silver title gradient and a precise photo frame. No large blue surface blocks. Existing authentic imagery, story carousel, videos/articles and membership behavior are preserved; exchanges appear only after website login.
editorialRevision.officialBranding: Authentic official YouTube banner wordmark replaces the earlier custom MM monogram; cyan brand symbol retained and used for the favicon.

frontendRevision.scope: Separate six-video section and five-item articles/commentary section; existing preview membership and three-step exchange account association preserved.
notes: Article filters operate only within #articles; all six videos remain visible in #watch. Membership events retain the selected article filter.
Member flows remain frontend previews using tab session storage, with an in-memory fallback. No real authentication, email delivery or Discord OAuth is connected.
Exchange verification defaults to preview. A future provider hook has a server-owned invitation contract; changing mode does not create a backend.
The public homepage and authentication dialog contain no exchange exposure. After website sign-in, Member Hub offers only WEEX onboarding. Other exchange listings and configuration have been removed.
Log In and signup dialogs offer email only. The Discord alternative button, divider, auth entry handler and obsolete CSS have been removed.

Compact single-column authentication: Log In and Sign Up headings distinguish modes, with one contextual switch below the form. Removed repeated marketing/sidebar/tab content and consolidated demo/storage copy. Website signup, email code flow and member callbacks remain intact.
